state_name: Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi
extraction_notes: Fiscal deficit and primary deficit are reported as positive magnitudes, as per instructions. Revenue deficit and primary deficit are reported as 0 because the state had a surplus in these categories for the audit year. Capital outlay as % of GSDP was calculated using absolute figures for Capital Expenditure (3754.30 crore from Page 19, Table 1.2) and GSDP (622384.64 crore from Page 18, Table 1.1). 'raised_this_year' refers to the number of grants with excess expenditure requiring regularisation for the current year (Page 41, Para 2.3.2). 'outstanding_over_5_years' is the count of grants with excess expenditure requiring regularisation for years prior to 2011-12 (calculated from Page 41, Table 2.2). 'money_value_of_observations_crore' is the total money value of excess expenditure requiring regularisation from previous years (Page 41, Table 2.2).
